sources.title: DNR Decommissioning All Wisconsin Fire Towers

notes_for_editor: The gone status rests on the FFLOS Wisconsin list alone, with no removal date. The 2015 DNR decision covers all 72 state towers, but no source read names Dunbar in it, so the story presents it as context only. A Feb 2016 Bay Cities report says Marinette County was left with two unmanned towers near Cedarville and Middle Inlet and does not name Dunbar; it is not cited. The FFLOS detail page (firetower.org/lookouts/us/wi/dunbar-lookout-site/) returned 404 and is not in the crawl cache. The OSM node 353893460 is named 'Dunbar Lookout Tower' with ele 392 and is not cited.
